dek: Inflation in Hong Kong eased in July, government figures showed on Thursday, with consumer prices rising by 1.7 percent year on year, compared with a 2 percent increase in June. Officials said the smaller increase was mainly due to rates concession in July this year. Figures released by the Census and Statistics Depart
